title: isoCirc catalogs full-length circular RNA isoforms in human transcriptomes
boundary: Enrich native circRNA with rRNA removal/RNaseR, reverse transcribe, remove RT-product overhangs by nuclease digestion, ligate circular cDNA and amplify that DNA circle by RCA for nanopore reads. The overhang-trimming/cDNA-circle construction boundary differs from registered R2C2 Gibson-splint preparation and from RNA-circle RCRT/CirSeq; admission is not based only on circRNA target class or software.

title: circFL-seq reveals full-length circular RNAs with rolling circular reverse transcription and nanopore sequencing
boundary: Native circRNA enrichment precedes rolling-circle reverse transcription from P1-N6. First-strand cDNA is polyA-tailed, second strand is made with P2-T24 anchor and P1/P2 PCR creates nanopore library. This RNA-templated repeat synthesis and cDNA tail/anchor-strand construction differs from isoCirc DNA-circle RCA and from registered CirSeq artificial RNA-fragment circularization; not an isoform-software or tissue-only variant.

title: Nanopore sequencing of brain-derived full-length circRNAs reveals circRNA-specific exon usage, intron retention and microexons
boundary: After circRNA enrichment/linear-RNA depletion, gentle hydrolysis nicks RNA circles and linearized RNA ends are healed and polyadenylated before ONT cDNA-PCR sequencing. It samples single-copy opened RNA templates rather than DNA-circle RCA or intact-RNA RCRT concatemers. The same paper circPanel-LRS targeted alternative is retained as one paper/branch, not extra panel/species entries.
